title: The story of SineDay
source: Current Discover More narrative in index.html; official SineDuckFinale17.svg rasterization

scenes.label: DISCOVER SINEDAY
scenes.title:
What is
a SineDay?
scenes.caption:
A SineDay is your place in
an 18-day personal rhythm.

scenes.label: A REFLECTIVE FRAMEWORK
scenes.title: An inner wave.
scenes.caption:
A way to reflect on energy,
feeling, and awareness.
Your cycle is counted from birth.
Not a scientific measurement.

scenes.label: RHYTHM
scenes.title:
Your inner power
has a rhythm.
scenes.caption:
Some days rise. Some days soften.
Some days ask you to listen
before you move.

scenes.label: PERSPECTIVE
scenes.title:
Notice the wave
within you.
scenes.caption:
SineDay gives you a simple way
to notice the wave within you,
without forcing it into
a rule or prediction.

scenes.label: AWARENESS
scenes.title:
Awareness changes
the moment.
scenes.caption:
When you know the shape of
today’s wave, the day becomes
easier to meet.

scenes.label: A CLEARER MIRROR
scenes.title:
Meet your day
as it is.
scenes.caption:
Not because SineDay tells you
what to do, but because it gives
you a clearer mirror for what
you are already feeling.

scenes.label: DAILY REFLECTION
scenes.title:
Journal from your
inherent power.
scenes.caption:
SineDay turns daily reflection
into a ritual. Today’s Wave,
Today’s Duck, and Today’s Thoughts
help you write from the energy
of the day.

scenes.label: YOUR DAY, IN WORDS
scenes.title:
Remember
what mattered.
scenes.caption:
So you can remember
what happened, what moved you,
and what mattered.

scenes.label: MEET SINEDUCK
scenes.title:
Hello, I’m
SineDuck.
scenes.caption:
I’m here to help you notice
the wave already moving
through your days.

scenes.label: MOVEMENT
scenes.title: Some moments rise.
scenes.caption:
Some moments rise, while others
soften and carry you inward.

scenes.label: ALIGNMENT
scenes.title:
Alignment
Creates Lift.
scenes.caption:
That movement is why SineDay says:
Alignment Creates Lift.
But lift doesn’t mean staying
at the top of the wave.

scenes.label: WITHIN
scenes.title:
See the
natural flow.
scenes.caption:
It begins with seeing the natural
flow already moving within you.
SineDay doesn’t create that flow.

scenes.label: PERSPECTIVE
scenes.title: Already yours.
scenes.caption:
It gives you a perspective
for noticing what is already yours.
When you can meet the movement
as it is, you don’t have to fight
every high or low.

scenes.label: AWARENESS
scenes.title:
That awareness
is lift.
scenes.caption:
You can experience the moment
with more awareness,
and that awareness is lift.

scenes.label: YOUR COMPANION
scenes.title:
Highs or lows,
I’m always here.
scenes.caption:
Highs or lows, I’m always here,
offering a perspective
free of judgment.
